title: Human review packet for RAG chunk candidates
description: Groups RAG-005 chunk candidates into source-mapping, topic-mapping, quote-review, and first-slice review queues before any runtime promotion.
notes: This checkpoint creates review queues only.
Source suggestions are hints, not automatic mappings.
It does not import chunks into runtime memory or enable retrieval.
Human review is required before any chunk can become a runtime RAG knowledge candidate.
